visibleFocus.rule: Every keyboard-operable interaction has a visible focus indicator that is not fully obscured.

targetAccess.rule: Pointer targets meet or are spaced to meet the WCAG 2.2 target-size minimum, including its documented exceptions.

reducedMotion.rule: Nonessential motion triggered by interaction is disabled or reduced when the user requests reduced motion; information never depends on animation.

adaptableText.rule: Type and layout remain usable with browser zoom and user text-spacing overrides.

typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
typography.rule: These are familiar starting stacks, not required downloads, fixed hierarchies, or identity assets.

rhythm.rule: Use the anchors to recognize related density, not as an exclusive spacing scale.

shape.rule: Zero radius, intermediate values, pills, and circles remain valid when function or surface expression calls for them.

focus.rule: This is a useful starting treatment, not required geometry; the visible-focus requirement is authoritative.

motion.rule: Durations are reference tempos. Surfaces own easing, properties, and whether motion is warranted.

editorial.description: Expressive type hierarchy, generous section rhythm, and mixed card and control shapes for reading and teaching.

application.description: Compact type and rhythm, strong operational grouping, and square or low-radius geometry where density benefits.

embedded.description: Neutral, host-controlled defaults that inherit surrounding typography and theme without becoming an OpenBindings skin.

terminal.description: Terminal-owned fonts and metrics, with density expressed through indentation, whitespace, labels, and native emphasis.

identityComposition.rule: The glyph may sit beside the correctly spelled OpenBindings name in any legible typography and composition appropriate to the surface.
